added_candidate: H0t = H0's 32 networks (networks_v29_h0.sha, unchanged) with the D9 tree heads (67fd2caa…) at the G1 weights li_scored .26, r_axis .14, kappa .09, x_lower_r .16; deployed finisher; sub-frame features. One Development submission with MAST v11.
disclosure: This candidate is chosen after seeing three public scores: the member set is the one that scored best in public, and the blend is the one whose public sign was positive. It is a selection on the public test (874 shots) and is reported as such; the blend's weights and the networks are not tuned on it. The expected gain (+3e-5) is of the order of what a selection among four candidates can produce by chance, so the Final-phase claim rests on the out-of-fold evidence (D9-0, D18-0), not on this score.
rule: Deploy H0t if its public d3d_S >= .996233 (H0 + 1e-5); otherwise the display is restored with the H0 pointer. H1 (64 members) is scored when its build ends and enters the same comparison: the display ends on the best of {H0, H1, H0t} that exceeds H0 by 1e-5, else H0.
follow_up_not_part_of_this_rule: Why the h family lowers the score is examined off the public test: per-family ensembles of the K-fold networks on the out-of-fold frames (flux coordinates and heads). A family subset is adopted for the final recipe only on that evidence.
